name: Payments & Public Finance
definition: Payments and public finance covers government-to-person disbursements, procurement spending, treasury reporting, and fiscal transparency.
summary: Movement of public funds with transparency and accountability.

challenges: Leakage and identity issues in G2P are common; procurement opacity and delayed payments create inefficiency and fraud risk.
